outcome: admission to a neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: All births that occurred in Oregon during 2012 and 2013
finding: Planned out-of-hospital birth was associated with a higher rate of perinatal death than was planned in-hospital birth, but the absolute risk of death was low in both settings.
